name: lists-02
description: A dated changelog list with version tags.

const releases = [ { version: "v4.2.0", date: "Nov 04, 2026", tag: "Feature", title: "460+ blocks on designali.com", items: [ "New hero, pricing and testimonial blocks", "Copy any block as React and Tailwind code", "Every block now uses @designali/icons", ], }, { version: "v4.1.3", date: "Oct 21, 2026", tag: "Fix", title: "Icon and logo fixes", items: [ "@designali/icons SVGs now preserve stroke alignment", "@designali/logos wordmarks render sharper at small sizes", ], }, { version: "v4.1.0", date: "Oct 02, 2026", tag: "Improvement", title: "Templates, revisited", items: [ "Portfolio and design agency templates refreshed", "240+ landing pages with dark mode", "Semantic design tokens across every template", ], }, ] export default function Lists02() { return (

Changelog

New Designali templates, blocks and icons, shipped every other week.

{releases.map((release) => (

{release.version}

{release.date}

{release.tag}

{release.title}

    {release.items.map((item) => (
  • {item}
    • ))}
))}
) }
